card.name: End of warning section headings
card.fires_on: The last word or colon of a warning heading in a label's Warnings and Precautions section, right before the paragraph text begins. Examples are a colon after a condition name or the last word of a heading.

modes.label: Colon after heading
modes.description: A colon right after a condition name that heads a warnings item.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypocortisolism<< :>> Hypocortisolism has been reported

modes.label: Last word of heading
modes.description: The final word of a numbered warning subsection title.
modes.example: 5.4 Transmission of Infectious<< Diseases>> SYMVESS is manufactured using cells

modes.label: Early in warning text
modes.description: A word just after the heading, as the warning sentence starts.
